# Feature Task (Spec-first)

Use this when starting a non-trivial feature.

```text
Implement a JTetris feature with spec-first flow.
1) If no active spec exists, create one from doc/specs/_feature-spec-template.md.
2) Fill scope, file allowlist, checklist, acceptance, and verification plan.
3) Implement only checklist item 1.
4) Keep all edits inside allowlist.
5) Run mvn clean test.
6) Update spec Verification and add a context-pack entry.
```
